trello.on_model_event.description: Triggers when actions occur on a Trello board, list, or card.

configInputs.modelId: ID of the Trello board, list, or card to watch.
configInputs.actionTypes: Optional Trello action types to filter events.

outputs.deliveryId: Unique delivery ID for this event.
outputs.modelId: ID of the Trello board, list, or card to watch.
outputs.body: Original webhook or polled event payload.
